title: Attachment Flow Regulating EPC Solenoid Open Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses an open circuit in the attachment flow rate adjustment EPC solenoid circuit.
controller_action: • None in particular. (Since no current flows, the solenoid is not energized.) • If the cause of the failure disappears, the machine becomes normal by itself.
related_information: Monitoring code The drive current to the attachment flow rate adjustment EPC solenoid can be monitored. (Code: 01700)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of checking method, see “RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
